line.name: DBL Chengo
line.description: Named after DBL's lead Dominican tobacco farmer; founder Francisco Almonte called it the brand's strongest release to date. Regular production, released May 2025.
line.wrapper: Mexican Habano, or Mexican San Andres Maduro
line.binder: Dominican Republic (variety unconfirmed - one source suggests Sumatra-seed, not corroborated elsewhere)

vitolas.name: Habano
vitolas.notes: Matches the Mac photo ('Chen-Mad' is actually the Maduro variant - see below; this entry covers the confirmed single size offered in both wrappers).

research_notes: A 3rd Mac photo ('DBL_Cheng-Clar_Box-Open_01.jpg') implies a 'Claro' wrapper variant, but every source found for Chengo's May 2025 launch lists only Habano and Maduro - no Claro/Connecticut/Natural variant confirmed anywhere.
